description: Shell library for testing credential handling including helpers, with functions for checking, rejecting, and testing credential helpers, as well as scripts for simulating askpass prompts.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Runs a credential helper command with provided arguments, compares output and error streams to expected values.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from input until '--' is encountered, outputs the lines.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans residual data from previous tests by rejecting various credentials.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects credentials for a given protocol, host, and username.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Performs a series of tests on a specified credential helper, including storing, retrieving, overwriting, and deleting credentials, as well as handling long headers and timeouts.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing, retrieving, and overwriting password expiry times.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credential information, including capabilities and ephemeral data.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a shell script for simulating askpass prompts.
